newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia HPI debuts at 6.85 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia HPI debuts at 6.85 ringgit.

text.p: Malaysian packaging maker HPI Resources Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board on Friday at 6.85 ringgit, against a 3.10 ringgit offer price.
At 0132 GMT, the company's stock was at 6.60 ringgit. It offered a total of 8.239 million shares in the issue. HPI makes corrugated carton packaging products.
For the year ended May 31, 1996, the company reported net profit of 7.20 million ringgit or 23.6 cents a share on turnover of 107.03 million ringgit.

It has estimated net profit of 7.83 million ringgit or 22.36 cents a share for the year ended May 31, 1997. The earnings per share figure is based on the enlarged issued and paid-up share capital of 35 million shares.
